text: Ɓen ɓe yoga e sirkooɓe ɓen wi'annoo: "Pellet Qurayshi en e ɗowro Abuu Sufyaana mooɓondiranii on e ɗuuɗal fii haɓugol on mula fii mon, reŋtee e maɓɓe hulon ɓe". Kan haala hulineede ɓeydaali ɓe si wanaa goongingol Alla hooloo fodoore Makko nden, ɓe yalti haɓoygol hiɓe wi'a: "Alla Toowuɗo On yonii men, O yonii yonndinorteeɗo".
